values.query: SELECT provider, pgp_sym_decrypt(access_token, $2) as access_token FROM oauth_tokens WHERE client_id = $1

parameters.url: ={{ $json[0]?.provider === 'gmail' ? 'https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/primary/events?timeMin=' + $('Receive Input').item.json.start_time + '&timeMax=' + $('Receive Input').item.json.end_time : 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/events?$filter=start/dateTime ge ' + "'" + $('Receive Input').item.json.start_time + "'" + ' and end/dateTime le ' + "'" + $('Receive Input').item.json.end_time + "'" }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($json[0]?.provider === 'gmail' ? { summary: $('Receive Input').item.json.title, start: { dateTime: $('Receive Input').item.json.start_time, timeZone: 'Africa/Lagos' }, end: { dateTime: $('Receive Input').item.json.end_time, timeZone: 'Africa/Lagos' }, description: $('Receive Input').item.json.description } : { subject: $('Receive Input').item.json.title, start: { dateTime: $('Receive Input').item.json.start_time, timeZone: 'Africa/Lagos' }, end: { dateTime: $('Receive Input').item.json.end_time, timeZone: 'Africa/Lagos' }, body: { contentType: 'text', content: $('Receive Input').item.json.description } }) }}

values.query: INSERT INTO calendar_events (client_id, provider, event_id, summary, start_time, end_time) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
